labels.reason: Historical reviewer: Most "world-class" hits are genuine corporate-speak TPs. FPs arise when "next level" is used literally for an organizational hierarchy level or a karate belt rank (not as a vague intensifier), and when "world-class research universities" is a factual descriptor for institutions that are objectively globally ranked, not a hollow boast.
